description: This source file defines the 'PagePreview' class within the PdfSharp.Forms namespace, which provides a Windows Forms control for previewing PDF pages. It handles rendering the visual representation of a PDF page, supports zooming, scrolling, and custom rendering via delegates, and manages control layout and drawing details.

classes.name: PagePreview
classes.description: A Windows Forms control for previewing PDF pages with zoom and scroll capabilities, rendering via delegates, and customizable appearance.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Releases resources used by the control.

methods.name: CalculatePreviewDimension
methods.description: Calculates the size and zoom level for the preview based on control size and zoom settings.

methods.name: RenderPage
methods.description: Renders the PDF page onto the provided Graphics object, calling the delegate for custom drawing.

methods.name: PaintBackground
methods.description: Paints the background of the preview, including page borders and shadows.

methods.name: SetScrollBarRange
methods.description: Adjusts the scroll bar ranges based on virtual page size and current offset.

methods.name: OnPaintBackground
methods.description: Overrides default background painting to draw page sheet and borders.

methods.name: OnSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles control resize events to recalculate preview dimensions.

methods.name: OnInvalidated
methods.description: Invalidates the canvas when the control needs repainting.

methods.name: OnLayout
methods.description: Arranges child controls for scrollbars and the canvas.

methods.name: CalculatePreviewDimension (internal overload)
methods.description: Performs detailed calculation of zoom level and page rectangle based on control size.

methods.name: RenderPage (internal)
methods.description: Handles rendering of the page content onto Graphics, applying zoom and transforms.
